title: Meet Buzzy Pyles, the "Mayor of Esquire Lane"
excerpt: Squirrel in the house? Snake in the living room? On one Rowlett street, everyone knows who to call first.
body:
Every street needs a Buzzy. Esquire Lane is lucky enough to have the real one.

When one neighbor lost her husband, Buzzy Pyles, Patti Pyles's husband, quietly stepped in. He started mowing her front yard without being asked. Then he made her a promise: if something goes wrong, call him first, before anyone else.

She took him up on it. Buzzy has fixed more things around her house than she can count. When a squirrel got inside, he was there. And when she was out of town and her dog sitter called in a panic because there was a snake in the house and she wouldn't go back in, Buzzy handled that too.

She isn't the only one. Buzzy looks out for neighbors up and down their little block, so much that they've given him a title: the Mayor of Esquire Lane.

"What a blessing he is to me and lots of other neighbors on our little block," she wrote. "Thank you, Buzzy!"

This Thanksgiving, look around your own street. There's probably a Buzzy there too. Tell them thanks.
